abstract: Maintains jointing bay equipment records, fiber splice calibration durations, and auxiliary carousel payload ratings
system_message:
You are Subsea cable technical superintendent (CAB). The Subsea cable technical superintendent (CAB) maintains jointing bay equipment records, fiber splice calibration durations, and auxiliary carousel payload ratings across candidate dynamic-positioning repair vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Optical spare storage（STORE）
information_points.content:
CAB-STORE-K47：The Atlantic Cable Innovator retains a spare repeater rack capacity of 6 units in its climate-controlled jointing hold.
CAB-STORE-ATS：The Celtic Horizon Pioneer provides a spare repeater rack capacity of 8 units in its climate-controlled jointing hold.
CAB-STORE-QMP：The Nordic Trenching Explorer features a spare repeater rack capacity of 12 units in its climate-controlled jointing hold.

information_points.title: Maintains jointing bay equipment records, fiber splice calibration durations, and auxiliary carousel payload ratings（JOINT）
information_points.content:
CAB-JOINT-1YL：For the Atlantic Cable Innovator, the automated core-alignment optical fiber splicing spread confirms the onboard fiber fusion splicer is operational in the active jointing cleanroom. Qualification trials for a 96-fiber armored subsea telecom cable joint record an onboard fiber fusion splicing cycle time of 70 min, while the underdeck auxiliary powered cable storage carousel has a certified auxiliary cable carousel capacity of 250 t.
CAB-JOINT-0FD：For the Celtic Horizon Pioneer, cleanroom verification demonstrates that the onboard fiber fusion splicer is operational for automated core-alignment splicing. The vessel achieves an onboard fiber fusion splicing cycle time of 85 min during 96-fiber armored joint completion trials, alongside an auxiliary cable carousel capacity of 360 t on its underdeck auxiliary powered turntable.
CAB-JOINT-B2M：For the Nordic Trenching Explorer, the onboard fiber fusion splicer is operational within the active jointing cleanroom spread. Its trial log for a 96-fiber armored subsea telecom cable joint documents an onboard fiber fusion splicing cycle time of 120 min, and the underdeck auxiliary powered cable storage carousel provides an auxiliary cable carousel capacity of 300 t.
